statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
There is concern for a potential transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) was ordered
The service is supported by diagnosis code G45.9
The service is supported by diagnosis code R42
The service is supported by diagnosis code Z86.73
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The service is medically necessary to identify arrhythmias that could explain these symptoms
